brief.aim: Predict the progesterone-receptor (PR) status of breast tumours in CPTAC-BRCA from RNA-seq gene expression. Compare several classifiers with cross-validation on the training rows, and report discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analysis for the selected model.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject structure is visible; sample_id is unique per row, so each tumour contributes a single profile.
brief.unit: One breast tumour sample (one RNA-seq expression profile per row)
